# lectio_wrapper

**Tag**: tooling

## 简介

A client wrapper for Lectio. Everything runs and is scraped without thirdparty. This means it is as secure as typical Lectio browsing.

## 官网

- 主页: https://oscarspalk.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/oscarspalk/lectio_wrapper
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/lectio_wrapper
